scripts.bootstrap: AX_SKIP_SKILL_INSTALL=1 pnpm install && [ -f db/graphjin/dev.example.yml ] && [ ! -f db/graphjin/dev.yml ] && cp db/graphjin/dev.example.yml db/graphjin/dev.yml || true
scripts.dev:up: mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/openneko" .openneko && if [ ! -s .openneko/development-backup-key ]; then openssl rand -hex 32 > .openneko/development-backup-key && chmod 600 .openneko/development-backup-key; fi && OPENNEKO_CONFIG_VOLUME="$HOME/.config/openneko" docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.adventureworks.yml up -d neko-db neko-graphjin graphjin adventureworks-simulator adventureworks-scenario-injector
scripts.dev:setup: pnpm dev:up && (cd apps/openneko && go run ./cmd/openneko migrate) && pnpm dev:seed
scripts.openneko: OPENNEKO_WORKSPACE_ROOT="$PWD" sh -c 'cd apps/openneko && exec go run ./cmd/openneko "$@"' --
